Karnataka Cabinet Expanded with 19 New Ministers; Siddaramaiah Skips Swearing-In

Karnataka's cabinet has been expanded with the swearing-in of 19 new ministers. The expansion follows the Congress party's victory in the state elections. Notably, senior Congress leader Siddaramaiah did not attend the swearing-in ceremony. Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar stated that "all's well" amidst Siddaramaiah's absence.
